entries.title: First pull: 12 houses fit
entries.lede: First data pull for the Prescott house hunt. I checked 8 listing sources and found 12 whole-house rentals with 5+ bedrooms or 4 bedrooms plus a den/office/loft. The strongest fit right now is 1478 Varsity Dr, Prescott (5 BR, $2,900, about 11 min to campus).

top.text: 1478 Varsity Dr, Prescott — 5 BR, $2,900, 11 min to ERAU, available now: ~54 days of rent before dec 1 unless landlord holds it
486 Robin Dr, Prescott — 4 + den (per listing), $3,150, 6 min to ERAU, available now: ~54 days of rent before dec 1 unless landlord holds it
117 N Equestrian Way, Prescott — 5 BR, $3,250, 17 min to ERAU, available now: ~54 days of rent before dec 1 unless landlord holds it

entries.market: 12 houses currently match (5+ BR or 4 + den, within ~35 min of campus). Asking rents run $2,544–$8,500, median $3,075; 5 are at or under the $2,900 reference. 10 are within 25 min; 0 list a move-in date in the Dec 1 window.
